newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thirsty Thais picked up for violating liquor ban.
newsitem.headline: Thirsty Thais picked up for violating liquor ban.

text.p: At least two dozen Bangkok residents, whose desire for a drink was stronger than fear of the law, were arrested on Sunday for breaking a temporary liquor ban during a general election.
Police said 24 Bangkokians were arrested on Sunday morning for violating the law that bans the sale or consumption of alcohol from 6 p.m. on Saturday night to 6 a.m. on Monday morning.
The ban is in place to ensure an orderly vote, election officials said. Offenders face jail terms of one to five years or a fine of up to 50,000 baht ($2,000).
In the July 1995 election, 58 people were prosecuted for the offence.
A total of 38 million Thais are eligible to cast votes in Sunday's general election.
